messages:
sam_support: Customer hit a tool-call 400 when they pasted a command from Outlook. They say it worked when typed manually. Error from our logs: "json parse error: invalid character '“' (U+201C)". Can someone help repro and advise a workaround?

mike_support: Do we have the raw payload + parser error?

sam_support: Pasting the minimal request they sent below (copied from their support message). Note the quotes look normal in Outlook but are curly when pasted. They also had a trailing comma because Outlook added one when copying a list.

sam_support: ```
POST /v1/call_tool
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tool": "shell",
  "args": {
    "cmd": "echo “Hello, world!”",
  },
}
```

sam_support: Server log snippet: `parser_error: invalid character '\u201C' at offset 64` and `schema_error: trailing comma at object end`

aya_eng: This is a classic RTF/Outlook clipboard artifact + trailing-comma issue. When RTF->plain text conversion happens, some clients replace straight quotes with U+201C/U+201D and can introduce soft-hyphen/U+00AD or an extra comma when copying lists. Our JSON parser fails on the curly quote and then the schema validator complains about the trailing comma.

aya_eng: Quick repro: open Word/Outlook, type: `echo "Hello, world!"`, copy from a reply and paste into a plain-text editor — you'll often see curly quotes. Also try copying a small CSV/list and some clients append a trailing comma.

jordan_se: For now we should: 1) tell the customer a workaround, 2) add a sanitizer in our proxy to normalize quotes/control chars before parsing, 3) add better 4xx error text to say "invalid characters (smart-quotes/control-chars) or trailing commas in tool args" so support can give actionable guidance.

mike_support: Workaround to give customer: paste into Notepad (or any plain-text editor) and re-copy to strip RTF, or send args as a fenced code block in the UI. Also removing the trailing comma fixes it. I'll DM them the short steps.

aya_eng: Suggested sanitizer rules for a hotfix PR: normalise Unicode quotes to ASCII (U+201C/U+201D/U+2018/U+2019 => ' or \"'), remove soft hyphen U+00AD and other control chars (except \t/\n if allowed), and run a quick trailing-comma stripper with a safe parse attempt (regex to remove ",\n\s*([}\]])" patterns before parsing). Add telemetry when sanitizer makes changes so we can see freq.

jordan_se: Also add a defensive parse path that returns 422 with an example of the offending char and a link to a short KB article. Right now parser gives opaque "invalid JSON" which isn't helpful.

deploybot: Branch created: `eng/sanitize-toolargs/1719004321-hotfix` — CI triggered.

aya_eng: I'll open the PR and add unit tests simulating Outlook copy/paste (smart quotes + trailing comma + U+00AD).

mike_support: Thanks — I'll update the customer with the Notepad workaround and tell them we're working on a server-side fix.

sam_support: Tagging @aya_eng for follow-up. Leaving a note to check size/latency impact of sanitizer.

aya_eng: Noted. I'll include perf microbenchmarks in the PR. Also will include a link to the KB draft in the PR description.

jordan_se: Good. Low-severity but high-touch. If we see more, we should add a small client-side sanitizer in our SDKs too. :thumbsup:
